subject: Supplier portal access & PO setup — Aperture Logistics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier portal access & PO setup — Aperture Logistics

Hi Jenna,

Great to meet you on the call earlier — thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor setup. To get Aperture fully activated in our procurement system and enable PO issuance we need the items below from your side. I’ve attached a lightweight CSV (Vendor_Setup_Sheet.csv) and a PO-routing template to make this quick.

What we need from you (please upload to the portal or reply to this thread):
- Legal entity name and DBA (if different)
- W-9 (PDF) or W-8 BEN (if non-US)
- Company tax ID / EIN
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, account # last 4, routing number)
- Remittance email and invoice format (PDF / EDI / CSV)
- Primary AP contact name, phone, and email
- Preferred payment terms (e.g., Net-30)
- Completed vendor questionnaire (attached CSV)

What we’ll do on our side: 
- Create vendor record (vendor code: provisional APTR-2026)
- Send portal invite to your AP contact so you can upload documents directly
- Issue initial PO once bank details and W-9 are validated

Attachments: Vendor_Setup_Sheet.csv (csv), PO-routing-template.xlsx (xlsx)

Can you send the W-9 and bank details today? If you prefer to upload, let me know the email to invite to the portal.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0184

- Bank verification: initiate micro-deposit to account provided (send details to AP contact when complete)
- Create vendor record in Coupa (vendor code: APTR-2026) and set default GL 5002
- Tax withholding flag: None (domestic supplier)
- Invoice routing: invoices@aperturelogistics.com (confirmed by Jenna)
- Payment terms: Net-30 (approved)

Attachments: vendor-record-template.csv (internal stub)

I will start the Coupa vendor creation today and schedule the micro-deposit.
